lines.text: David escapes to Gath with his six hundred men, and Achish son of Maoch is king there.
Saul stops searching for David, and Achish gives David the town of Ziklag.
David lives among the Philistines a year and four months and raids the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Hittites.
David takes flocks, herds, donkeys, camels, and clothing, and leaves no one alive so nobody can report him to Achish.
Achish tells David to go to battle against Israel with him and promises to make him his commander for life.
